summary.en: A chef named Shigeru Unagizuka, who is also the owner of Ginpachi Unagi Shop, was injured in the leg and could not make a delivery, so Genta decided to help him. He coincidentally meets Conan, Haibara, Mitsuhiko, and Ayumi on the way. Unfortunately, the chef is discovered to be seriously injured by a stab wound to the left side of the chest and is currently being treated in the hospital in critical condition. This makes Genta extremely angry and determined to make the culprit pay for what he has done.

suspects: Yuya Kurashima, Hiroyuki Okamoto and Rio Matsui
suspectsZh: 仓岛悠也、冈本博之与松井理央
